reflections.what_worked: Nothing really. Simple motifs were least bad, but still unsatisfactory.
reflections.frustrations: Very frustrating session. DDSP clearly not designed for this use case. Wasted 90 minutes trying different approaches. Audio quality degraded significantly with complex melodic content.
reflections.discoveries: DDSP has clear limitations for fast, articulated melodic content. Seems optimized for sustained tones and bass/rhythmic material. MIDI input surprisingly unhelpful.
reflections.comparisons: Yesterday's funk bass session was excellent; today's jazz melody was a disaster. System is highly content-dependent. Would use MusicGen or even traditional synthesis for this task instead.
reflections.emotional_state: Started hopeful (based on yesterday's success), ended frustrated and disappointed. Need to better understand system limitations upfront.

description.what_happened: DDSP completely failed to generate usable jazz melodic content across 4 different approaches
description.goal: Generate bebop-style saxophone melody for jazz composition
description.expected: Based on yesterday's bass success, expected good results with proper prompting/iteration
description.actual: All outputs were poor quality, lacked musical expression, lost jazz feel completely
description.why_notable: Reveals fundamental limitations of DDSP for certain content types. Important for understanding system boundaries.

context.prior_actions: Previous session with funk bass was highly successful, leading to optimistic expectations
context.system_state: Same DDSP v3.2.1, melody_v2 model, Web interface functioning normally

analysis.significance: Defines clear boundary of DDSP effectiveness: works well for bass/rhythmic content, fails for complex melodic lines
analysis.theoretical_insights: Audio-to-audio models may have content-type specialization based on training data or architecture. Fast transients + complex articulation seem problematic.
analysis.workflow_impact: Need to select appropriate system for content type. DDSP not suitable for melodic jazz, brass, or other fast/articulate instruments.

root_cause.evidence: Consistent failure across all approaches. Likely trained primarily on sustained/rhythmic content, not fast melodic lines.
root_cause.alternatives: User error possible but unlikely - tried multiple strategies. System simply seems poorly suited for this content.

learnings.system: DDSP has content-type limitations. Excellent for bass/rhythmic, poor for fast melodic/articulated content.
learnings.evaluation: Need to test system boundaries early to avoid wasting time on unsuitable use cases
learnings.practice: Don't assume success in one area transfers to all areas. Test diverse content types upfront.
learnings.approach_changes: Will create a system-suitability matrix based on content type before starting sessions
learnings.recommendations: DDSP documentation should clearly state optimal content types and limitations

reproducibility.steps: Attempt to generate fast melodic content (>120 BPM) with complex articulation using DDSP
reproducibility.conditions: Tested with audio input, MIDI input, various tempos - all failed

documentation.related: Contrasts with successful bass session (20251015). Links to Criteria 3, 4, 6.
